verses.text: Wisdom has built her house. She has carved its seven pillars.
She has prepared her meat and mixed her wine. She has set her table.
She has sent out her servant girls, and she calls from the highest places in the city:
"Let all who are simple come in here!" To those who have no sense she says,
"Come, eat my bread and drink the wine I have mixed.
Leave your simple ways and live. Walk on the path of understanding."
If you correct a mocker, you will get insulted. If you correct a wicked person, you will get hurt.
Do not correct mockers, or they will hate you. Correct wise people, and they will love you.
Teach wise people, and they will become even wiser. Teach good people, and they will learn even more.
Respect for the LORD is where wisdom begins. Knowing the Holy One is understanding.
Through wisdom you will live longer. Years will be added to your life.
If you are wise, you are the one who benefits. If you mock, you alone will suffer.
Foolishness is like a loud woman. She has no self-control and knows nothing.
She sits at the door of her house, on a seat at the highest point of the city,
calling out to people walking by, who are minding their own business:
"Let all who are simple come in here!" To those who have no sense she says,
"Stolen water is sweet. Food eaten in secret tastes good!"
But they do not know that the dead are there, that her guests are deep in the grave.
